to_befriend = phone_emails - venmo_emails
to_unfriend = venmo_emails - phone_emails

print("Venmo emails:", venmo_emails)
print("To befriend:", to_befriend)
print("To unfriend:", to_unfriend)

# Add missing friends to venmo
for email in to_befriend:
    result = apis.venmo.add_friend(user_email=email, access_token=venmo_token)
    print(f"Add {email}: {result}")

# Remove extra friends from venmo
for email in to_unfriend:
    result = apis.venmo.remove_friend(user_email=email, access_token=venmo_token)
    print(f"Remove {email}: {result}")

# Verify final venmo friends match phone friends
# Fetch all venmo friends (paginate if needed)
all_venmo_friends = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=venmo_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_venmo_friends.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

final_venmo_emails = {f['email'] for f in all_venmo_friends}
print("Final venmo emails:", final_venmo_emails)
print("Phone emails:", phone_emails)
print("Match:", final_venmo_emails == phone_emails)

# Parse the old songs list from the file content
old_songs_content = """# Archived Songs
- On the Border of Reality by Lily Moon, Zoey James
- The Tragedy of Living Without by Marcus Lane
- The Shadows That Haunt Us by Carter Knight
- Infinite Dreams by Lily Moon
- Violet Rain by Noah Bennett, Ethan Wallace, Nova Harmony
- Whispers of Destiny by Aria Sterling
- Caught in the Afterglow of Love by Grace Harrison
- Silent Sorrow by Aria Sterling
- A Tale of Unspoken Longing by Emily Rivers
- The Melancholy of Wasted Years by Felix Blackwood
- In the Theater of Broken Promises by Isabella Cruz
- Neon Reverie by Violet Cascade
- Longing for a Ghostly Touch by Aria Sterling
- Mystic Rhythms by Aria Sterling"""

# Parse lines that start with "- "
old_songs = []
for line in old_songs_content.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith("- "):
        line = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " to get title and artist part
        if " by " in line:
            title, artist_part = line.split(" by ", 1)
            # Artist part may have multiple artists separated by commas
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artist_part.split(",")]
            old_songs.append((title.strip(), artists))
        else:
            # No artist? skip or handle
            pass

print("Parsed old songs:")
for title, artists in old_songs:
    print(f"Title: {title}, Artists: {artists}")

# Parse the archive file content to extract song titles and artists
import re

content = file_data['content']
archive_songs = []
for line in content.split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Format: "- Title by Artist"
        song_str = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " to get title and artist
        parts = song_str.split(' by ')
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title = parts[0].strip()
            artist = parts[1].strip()
            archive_songs.append({'title': title, 'artist': artist})

print(f"Parsed {len(archive_songs)} songs from archive file")
for s in archive_songs:
    print(f"  - {s['title']} by {s['artist']}")

# Parse the archive file content to extract song titles and artists
import re

songs_to_archive = []
for line in file_data['content'].split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Format: "- Title by Artist"
        match = re.match(r'^- (.+) by (.+)$', line)
        if match:
            title = match.group(1).strip()
            artist = match.group(2).strip()
            songs_to_archive.append({'title': title, 'artist': artist})

print(f"Parsed {len(songs_to_archive)} songs to archive")
for song in songs_to_archive:
    print(song)

# Retrieve all playlists from Spotify (paginate through all pages)
all_playlists = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    playlists_page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    # Check if it's a list or dict with error
    if isinstance(playlists_page, dict) and 'message' in playlists_page:
        print("Error:", playlists_page)
        break
    if not playlists_page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(playlists_page)
    if len(playlists_page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total playlists found: {len(all_playlists)}")
for pl in all_playlists:
    print(pl)

# Process each playlist (skip the "Old Songs" playlist itself)
old_songs_playlist_id = 654
added_to_old_songs = set()

for playlist in all_playlists:
    playlist_id = playlist["playlist_id"]
    if playlist_id == old_songs_playlist_id:
        continue  # skip the target playlist
    title = playlist["title"]
    song_ids = playlist["song_ids"]
    # Find which songs in this playlist are in archive
    to_remove = [sid for sid in song_ids if sid in archive_song_ids]
    if not to_remove:
        print(f"Playlist '{title}' (id {playlist_id}): no archive songs")
        continue
    print(f"Playlist '{title}' (id {playlist_id}): removing {len(to_remove)} songs")
    for sid in to_remove:
        # Remove from this playlist
        apis.spotify.remove_song_from_playlist(
            playlist_id=playlist_id,
            song_id=sid,
            access_token=login_result["access_token"]
        )
        # Add to Old Songs if not already added
        if sid not in added_to_old_songs:
            apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(
                playlist_id=old_songs_playlist_id,
                song_id=sid,
                access_token=login_result["access_token"]
            )
            added_to_old_songs.add(sid)
            print(f"  Added song {sid} to Old Songs")
        else:
            print(f"  Song {sid} already in Old Songs, skipping add")

print(f"\nTotal unique songs added to Old Songs: {len(added_to_old_songs)}")

# Parse the songs to archive from the file content
import re

content = file_data['content']
songs_to_archive = []
for line in content.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove the leading "- "
        song_str = line[2:]
        # Split by " by " (last occurrence)
        # Use rsplit to split from right
        parts = song_str.rsplit(' by ', 1)
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title = parts[0].strip()
            artist = parts[1].strip()
            songs_to_archive.append({'title': title, 'artist': artist})

print("Songs to archive:", songs_to_archive)
print("Count:", len(songs_to_archive))

# Search for each song in the archive list to get their song_ids
archive_song_ids = []
for song in songs_to_archive:
    query = f"{song['title']} {song['artist']}"
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
    # Find exact match
    found = None
    for r in results:
        if r['title'] == song['title'] and any(a['name'] == song['artist'] for a in r['artists']):
            found = r
            break
    if found:
        archive_song_ids.append(found['song_id'])
        print(f"Found: {song['title']} by {song['artist']} -> song_id {found['song_id']}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {song['title']} by {song['artist']}")

print("Archive song IDs:", archive_song_ids)

print("Archive song IDs:", archive_song_ids)

# Track which songs have been added to Old Songs
added_to_old = set()

# Iterate over all playlists except the new "Old Songs" (ID 654)
for playlist in playlists:
    if playlist["playlist_id"] == 654:
        continue
    playlist_id = playlist["playlist_id"]
    playlist_title = playlist["title"]
    print(f"\nProcessing playlist: {playlist_title} (ID: {playlist_id})")
    
    # Get playlist details with songs
    detail = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=login_result["access_token"])
    songs = detail["songs"]
    print(f"  Total songs: {len(songs)}")
    
    # Find songs in this playlist that are in the archive set
    to_remove = [song for song in songs if song["id"] in archive_song_ids]
    print(f"  Songs to remove: {len(to_remove)}")
    
    for song in to_remove:
        song_id = song["id"]
        # Remove from this playlist
        remove_result = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_playlist(
            playlist_id=playlist_id,
            song_id=song_id,
            access_token=login_result["access_token"]
        )
        print(f"    Removed song {song_id} ({song['title']}) from playlist {playlist_title}")
        
        # Add to Old Songs if not already added
        if song_id not in added_to_old:
            add_result = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(
                playlist_id=654,
                song_id=song_id,
                access_token=login_result["access_token"]
            )
            added_to_old.add(song_id)
            print(f"    Added song {song_id} ({song['title']}) to Old Songs")
        else:
            print(f"    Song {song_id} already in Old Songs, skipping add")

print("\nAll done!")

        # Split on " by " to get title and artist

    for song_id in playlist['song_ids']:
        all_song_ids.add(song_id)
        if song_id not in song_to_playlists:

# Parse the old songs list from the file content
import re

content = file_data['content']
old_songs = []
for line in content.split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Format: "- Song Title by Artist1, Artist2"
        song_part = line[2:]  # remove "- "
        # Split on " by " (last occurrence)
        if ' by ' in song_part:
            title, artists_str = song_part.rsplit(' by ', 1)
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            old_songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists': artists})
        else:
            print(f"Skipping malformed line: {line}")

print(f"Parsed {len(old_songs)} old songs:")
for s in old_songs:
    print(f"  {s['title']} by {', '.join(s['artists'])}")

# Let's check the current state of songs_to_archive to see which songs we've already matched
print(songs_to_archive)

# We'll create a mapping of song title -> song_id by searching each song.
# We'll match by title and artists (case-insensitive).
song_id_map = {}
for song in songs_to_archive:
    title = song['title']
    artists = song['artists']
    # Build query with title and artists
    query = title + ' ' + ' '.join(artists)
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, access_token=spotify_token)
    # Find the first result that matches title and artists
    found = None
    for r in results:
        if r['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check artists match (all artists in the song should be in the result's artists)
            result_artists = [a['name'] for a in r['artists']]
            if all(any(ra.lower() == a.lower() for ra in result_artists) for a in artists):
                found = r['song_id']
                break
    if found is not None:
        song_id_map[title] = found
        print(f"Matched: {title} -> {found}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {title}")

print("song_id_map:", song_id_map)

# Parse the file content to extract song titles and artists
import re

file_content = """# List of Songs to Archive
- City of Fallen Angels by Hazel Winter
- Sacred Ground by Noah Bennett
- Echoes from the Abyss by Noah Bennett
- Beneath the Surface of Love by Velvet Echo
- Lost in the Maze of Your Mind by Noah Bennett
- Crimson Veil by Phoenix Rivers
- In the Wake of Goodbye by Lucas Grey
- The Puzzle of My Heart by Jasper Skye, Isabella Cruz, Seraphina Dawn
- A Broken Heart's Lament by Lucas Diaz
- Whispers of a Forgotten Love by Lily Moon, Zoey James
- Strangers Again by Oceanic Odyssey
- When Dawn Breaks Without You by Lucas Grey
- Secrets of the Heart by Carter Knight
"""

# Extract lines starting with "- "
song_lines = [line.strip() for line in file_content.splitlines() if line.startswith("- ")]
songs_to_archive = []
for line in song_lines:
    # Remove leading "- " and split on " by "
    line = line[2:]
    if " by " in line:
        title, artist = line.split(" by ", 1)
        songs_to_archive.append((title.strip(), artist.strip()))
    else:
        # If no " by ", treat whole as title
        songs_to_archive.append((line.strip(), ""))

print("Parsed songs:")
for title, artist in songs_to_archive:
    print(f"  {title} - {artist}")

# Parse the file content to extract song titles and artists
import re

file_content = file_data["content"]
songs_to_archive = []
for line in file_content.split("\n"):
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith("#") or not line.startswith("-"):
        continue
    # Remove leading "- " and split on " by "
    line = line[2:].strip()
    if " by " in line:
        title, artists_str = line.split(" by ", 1)
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(",")]
        songs_to_archive.append({"title": title.strip(), "artists": artists})

print("Parsed songs to archive:")
for s in songs_to_archive:
    print(s)

# Parse the note content to find songs with RELEASED_AT TODO
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- " and trailing " RELEASED_AT TODO"
        line_clean = line.strip()
        if line_clean.startswith('- '):
            line_clean = line_clean[2:]
        # Split by " BY " to get title and artists part
        if ' BY ' in line_clean:
            title_part, artists_part = line_clean.split(' BY ', 1)
            # Remove " RELEASED_AT TODO" from artists_part
            artists_part = artists_part.replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '')
            songs_todo.append({'title': title_part, 'artists': artists_part})
print(songs_todo)

import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the first line (header)
song_lines = [line for line in lines if line.startswith('- ')]

songs = []
for line in song_lines:
    # Remove leading "- "
    line = line[2:]
    # Split by " BY " and " RELEASED_AT "
    parts = re.split(r' BY | RELEASED_AT ', line)
    if len(parts) == 3:
        title = parts[0].strip()
        artists = parts[1].strip()
        release = parts[2].strip()
        songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'release': release})
    else:
        print("Unexpected format:", line)

# Show songs with TODO
todo_songs = [s for s in songs if s['release'] == 'TODO']
print("Songs with TODO:", len(todo_songs))
for s in todo_songs:
    print(s)

# Parse the note lines to extract title and artists for each TODO song
songs_to_update = []
for line in todo_lines:
    # Format: "- Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
    # Remove leading "- " and trailing " RELEASED_AT TODO"
    content = line[2:].replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '')
    # Split on " BY " to get title and artists
    parts = content.split(' BY ')
    title = parts[0]
    artists_str = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ''
    artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')] if artists_str else []
    songs_to_update.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})

# Parse the note content to extract songs and identify those missing release info
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
# Skip the first line (title)
song_lines = [line.strip() for line in lines if line.strip().startswith('- ')]

# Parse each line: format "- Title BY Artists RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY or TODO"
songs = []
for line in song_lines:
    # Remove leading "- "
    line = line[2:]
    # Split on " RELEASED_AT "
    parts = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
    if len(parts) != 2:
        continue
    song_part = parts[0]
    release_part = parts[1]
    # Split song_part on " BY " to get title and artists
    if ' BY ' in song_part:
        title, artists = song_part.split(' BY ', 1)
    else:
        title = song_part
        artists = ''
    songs.append({
        'title': title.strip(),
        'artists': artists.strip(),
        'release': release_part.strip()
    })

# Print songs that need release info
missing = [s for s in songs if s['release'] == 'TODO']

# Parse the note content to extract songs with TODO
import re

lines = note['content'].split('\n')
songs_to_update = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract title and artists
        # Format: "- Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        match = re.match(r'^- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT TODO$', line.strip())
        if match:
            title = match.group(1).strip()
            artists_str = match.group(2).strip()
            # Split artists by comma
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            songs_to_update.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
        else:
            print("Could not parse line:", line)

print(f"Found {len(songs_to_update)} songs to update")
for s in songs_to_update:
    print(s['title'], s['artists'])

# Search for each song and extract release date
import re

# We'll store results in a dict: title -> release_date (MM/YYYY)
release_dates = {}

for song in songs_to_update:
    title = song['title']
    artists = song['artists']
    # Search for the song
    result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
    # Find the matching song
    found = None
    for item in result:
        if item['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check if all artists match
            item_artists = [a['name'] for a in item['artists']]
            # Check if the set of artists matches (order may differ)
            if set(artists) == set(item_artists):
                found = item
                break
    if found:
        release_date = found['release_date']  # ISO format
        # Extract month and year
        # release_date is like "2021-03-02T14:08:32"
        year = release_date[:4]
        month = release_date[5:7]
        release_dates[title] = f"{month}/{year}"
        print(f"{title}: {release_dates[title]}")
    else:
        print(f"Could not find song: {title} by {artists}")

print("Done searching")

# Parse the note content to extract songs with RELEASED_AT TODO
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- ') and 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 ... RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- " and trailing " RELEASED_AT TODO"
        line_clean = line[2:].replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '')
        # Split on " BY " to get title and artists
        if ' BY ' in line_clean:
            title_part, artists_part = line_clean.split(' BY ', 1)
            songs_todo.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists_part.strip()})
        else:
            # fallback
            songs_todo.append({'title': line_clean.strip(), 'artists': ''})
print(songs_todo)

# Parse the note content to extract songs with RELEASED_AT TODO
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Extract song title and artists
        match = re.match(r'- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT (.+)', line)
        if match:
            title = match.group(1)
            artists = match.group(2)
            released_at = match.group(3)
            if released_at == 'TODO':
                songs_todo.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})

print(f"Found {len(songs_todo)} songs with TODO release info")
for s in songs_todo:
    print(s['title'], '-', s['artists'])

liked_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Get release dates for all liked songs

for song in liked_songs:
    detail = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song['song_id'])
    song_details.append(detail)
    print(f"{song['title']} - {detail['release_date']}")

# Parse the note content to extract songs with RELEASED_AT TODO
import re

note_content_str = note_content['content']
lines = note_content_str.split('\n')
# Skip the first line (header)
song_lines = [line for line in lines if line.startswith('- ')]
print("Number of song lines:", len(song_lines))

# Extract title and artists for each line
songs_to_update = []
for line in song_lines:
    # Pattern: "- Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
    match = re.match(r'- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT (\S+)', line)
    if match:
        title = match.group(1).strip()
        artists = match.group(2).strip()
        release = match.group(3).strip()
        if release == 'TODO':
            songs_to_update.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
    else:
        print("Could not parse line:", line)

print("Songs to update:", len(songs_to_update))
for s in songs_to_update:
    print(s['title'], "by", s['artists'])

# Parse the note content to extract songs with RELEASED_AT TODO
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
# Filter lines that start with '- '
song_lines = [line for line in lines if line.startswith('- ')]

# Extract title and artists for lines with TODO
todo_songs = []
for line in song_lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract title and artists
        # Format: - <title> BY <artists> RELEASED_AT TODO
        match = re.match(r'- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT TODO', line)
        if match:
            title = match.group(1).strip()
            artists = match.group(2).strip()
            todo_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})

print(f"Found {len(todo_songs)} songs with TODO")
for s in todo_songs:
    print(f"  {s['title']} BY {s['artists']}")

# Parse the note content to extract songs and identify those with TODO
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove the leading "- "
        entry = line[2:]
        # Split by " BY " to get title and rest
        if ' BY ' in entry:
            title_part, rest = entry.split(' BY ', 1)
            # rest contains artists and RELEASED_AT
            # Split by " RELEASED_AT " to get artists and release info
            if ' RELEASED_AT ' in rest:
                artists_part, release_part = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ', 1)
                artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
                release = release_part.strip()
                songs.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists, 'release': release})
            else:
                # malformed
                pass
        else:
            # malformed
            pass

# Print songs with TODO
for s in songs:
    if s['release'] == 'TODO':
        print(s)

# Parse the note content to extract songs with TODO release info
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract title and artists
        # Format: "- Title BY Artist1, Artist2 ... RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- "
        line_clean = line.strip()
        if line_clean.startswith('- '):
            line_clean = line_clean[2:]
        # Split on " BY " to get title and rest
        if ' BY ' in line_clean:
            title_part, rest = line_clean.split(' BY ', 1)
            # rest contains artists and RELEASED_AT TODO
            # Remove " RELEASED_AT TODO" from rest
            artists_part = rest.replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '')
            songs_todo.append({'title': title_part, 'artists': artists_part, 'line': line})
print(songs_todo)

# Parse the note content to extract songs
content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the header line
song_lines = [line.strip() for line in lines if line.startswith('- ')]

# Parse each song line
songs = []
for line in song_lines:
    # Format: - Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY or TODO
    # Split on " BY " and " RELEASED_AT "
    parts = line[2:].split(' BY ')
    title = parts[0]
    rest = parts[1]
    # Split on " RELEASED_AT "
    artist_part, release_part = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
    artists = artist_part.split(', ')
    songs.append({
        'title': title,
        'artists': artists,
        'release': release_part,
        'line': line
    })

# Parse the note content to extract songs with TODO
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
todo_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- " and trailing " RELEASED_AT TODO"
        song_part = line.strip()
        if song_part.startswith('- '):
            song_part = song_part[2:]
        song_part = song_part.replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '')
        # Split by " BY " to get title and artists
        if ' BY ' in song_part:
            title, artists = song_part.split(' BY ', 1)
            todo_songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists': artists.strip(), 'line': line})
        else:
            print(f"Could not parse line: {line}")
print(f"Found {len(todo_songs)} TODO songs")

# Parse the note content to extract songs and identify those with TODO
content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the first line (header)
song_lines = [line for line in lines if line.startswith('- ')]
print(f"Total song lines: {len(song_lines)}")

# Parse each line: format "- Title BY Artist RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY" or "RELEASED_AT TODO"
songs = []
for line in song_lines:
    # Remove leading "- "
    line = line[2:]
    # Split on " BY " to get title and rest
    if " BY " in line:
        title_part, rest = line.split(" BY ", 1)
        # rest contains artist(s) and RELEASED_AT
        # Find " RELEASED_AT " to separate artist and release info
        if " RELEASED_AT " in rest:
            artist_part, release_part = rest.split(" RELEASED_AT ", 1)
            release = release_part.strip()
            songs.append({
                'title': title_part.strip(),
                'artist': artist_part.strip(),
                'release': release
            })
        else:
            # No RELEASED_AT? Shouldn't happen but handle
            songs.append({
                'title': title_part.strip(),
                'artist': rest.strip(),
                'release': None
            })
    else:
        # No BY? skip or handle
        print(f"Line without BY: {line}")

# Print songs with TODO
todo_songs = [s for s in songs if s['release'] == 'TODO']
print(f"Songs with TODO: {len(todo_songs)}")
for s in todo_songs:
    print(f"  {s['title']} by {s['artist']}")

# Parse the note content to extract songs with TODO release info
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
todo_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artist
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- " and trailing " RELEASED_AT TODO"
        line_clean = line.strip()
        if line_clean.startswith('- '):
            line_clean = line_clean[2:]
        # Split on " BY " to get title and artist part
        parts = line_clean.split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title = parts[0].strip()
            artist_part = parts[1].replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '').strip()
            # Take first artist (before comma)
            first_artist = artist_part.split(',')[0].strip()
            todo_songs.append({'title': title, 'artist': first_artist, 'full_artist': artist_part})
print(todo_songs)

lines = note_content.split('\n')
new_lines = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title: part after "- " and before " BY "
        # Example: "- Silver Lining BY Ava Morgan RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Split on " BY " to get title part
        title_part = line.split(' BY ')[0]
        # Remove leading "- " and any extra spaces
        title = title_part.strip().lstrip('-').strip()
        # Look up date
        date = song_release_dates.get(title)
        if date:
            # Replace TODO with date
            line = line.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', f'RELEASED_AT {date}')
        else:
            print(f"Warning: No date found for song: {title}")
